title: Lisa R NDE 77
content: There was darkness but I was in a light and the light was warm, loving, and peaceful. It was God's light. I mean that is what he is. My soul was in his soul, light, or something like that. It was so wonderful I didn't want to leave but someone said I had to go back. I could hear my mum saying, "Don't you leave us! Lisa don't you leave us!" At times, I would come to and open my eyes. I would see my mum by my side, but then I would be back there in God's light. After I finely came back, I was so angry because I wanted to stay because it was so peaceful.

elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Darkness | Light | Boundary | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I know I wasn't in body form. I could tell it was my soul somehow.
elements.At what time during the experience were: Very good. I was in and out of consciousness. I was very alert because a nurse came in and kept asking me if I knew where I was, the date, and the day. I always knew.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning There was no sense of time. I felt like I was there for a long time but it was only a short time.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: Just my mum saying, ''Don't leave us.'' Later, I found out she wasn't saying it, she was thinking it.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Uncertain Not sure because the person who said I had to go back was different. I don't know why but I know I was told by someone else.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes The light was God and I was in the light.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Love, peace, at peace, warm, happy, calm, etc…..
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe Not at the time but afterwards. God made me see that if I want to be at peace that I needed to change things in my life.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control God is compassionate. He didn't think I was bad for trying to kill myself . He understood my pain and helped me find peace in life, instead of in death.
elements.Did you reach a boundary or limiting phy: No I sensed that it was the finest place, but I couldn't go there.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I was led to believe that killing your self was a sin and bad. But God was understanding and could feel my pain. I think if I was to try it again, God would keep me there. I don't know why but he would. but he knows I won't because he showed me how to be at peace here on earth.
elements.After the NDE: included: Presence of unearthly beings After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Uncertain It was like seeing without eyes; hearing without sound; and speaking without mouth or words. No real words to describe.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I could see or sense things. He was letting me know of what I had to do to be at peace here on earth.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The best was being in his light. The worst was being sent back.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Some people believe me. Some say they believe but I don't think they really do. I think they find it hard to come to terms with what I experienced because they have no frame of reference to compare it to on earth.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: There are so many things I can't put into to words to describe the experience.
